# CameraTexture

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("CameraTexture")`

A camera drawing into a texture (ADR 0107): whatever `Camera` sees is drawn into `view://` followed by `ViewName`, and anything that takes a texture -- an `ImageLabel` on a `SurfaceGui`, a `Decal`, a material's map -- can show it. A wall of security monitors is one of these per camera.

**A budget draws them**: at most `[render] max_views_per_frame` a frame (4 by default), the oldest picture first, so twelve monitors take turns instead of costing twelve views. Drawn before the main view, so a feed shows this frame's picture; a camera that sees its own texture sees the previous one. Rendering only: nothing here reaches the simulation, and a dedicated server draws nothing.

**It does not replicate**, because a camera does not -- a replica's view is its own. A feed is set up by the machine that draws it: in a match, a client script makes its cameras and their textures.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Camera` | `Camera?` | — | read/write | The camera it draws from. Nil draws nothing and keeps the last picture. |
| `Enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Off keeps the last picture and costs nothing. |
| `Quality` | `Enum.ViewQuality` | `Enum.ViewQuality.Simple` | read/write | `Simple` draws without shadows or the look's effects -- what a feed wants; `Full` draws the way the main view does. |
| `Resolution` | `Vector2` | `Vector2.new(512, 288)` | read/write | The texture's size in pixels. Capped at `[render] max_view_resolution` on a side (1024 by default); the cap keeps the shape. |
| `UpdateInterval` | `number` | `1` | read/write | Draw on one frame in this many. A wall of monitors at 4 costs a quarter of what it would at 1, and a security feed does not need more. |
| `ViewName` | `string` | — | read/write | The name it draws into: `view://` followed by this. Two with one name: the first made draws, and the second says so in the log. Until the first picture, the texture is black -- a screen that is off. |
